1.title: Main Stage
description: This place is the soul of the försztivál! Every day from early afternoon until dawn, this is where all the main events will take place, and where our performers will perform. It is the venue for a wide variety of events, details of which you will find in the Conbook. You will see, hear, and feel all of it!

2.title: NicoBar
description: The sun is setting, the music starts to rumble, lights came on in the party district with the night warming up the best cocktail bar in Fejér county, the NicoBar opens its doors serving Tiki cocktails and other specialities!
What is your favourite cocktail that you would like to see on the menu?

3.title: Suitlounge
description: Would you take a break while fursuiting? The suitlounge is always open, with a well-ventilated area and a wide range of refreshments and energy drinks that will keep you going. Access is restricted to fursuiters and their attendants only. No photos or videos are allowed in this area.

4.title: Artist Alley
description: Your favourite artists and all those you don't know yet are eager for you to visit their booth and to grab tangible memories from them! Maybe you will get a deal here on the fursuit of your dreams or get a wonderful piece of art. Keep your wallet close, just in case!

5.title: Raffle
description: It’s all down to luck here. Visit the raffle table in the Artist Alley, look for a prize of your liking and don't delay on buying your tickets!

6.title: Beach
description: If it's summer, then it's the waterfront! Jump right in the cooling waves of Lake Velence, enjoy the water and the sunshine! Access to the beach is unlimited during its opening hours!
The beach area is only open during its opening hours and only with a valid wristband. You can ask for a wristband at the registration desk for a deposit fee of 1000 HUF.

7.title: Jacuzzi
description: Would you like to relax in the foams of lukewarm water? Now you can do it on försztivál, while the whole of Vibe City is partying right in front of you!

8.title: Grill
description: The program that all försztivál attendees will definitely visit at least once. Every day from noon until dawn, the fire will be lit, and all the delicious food will be roasted on it. This program is of course weather dependent...
We will provide the firewood, utensils, and even some spices and sauces as long as we have them in stock, you just need to bring what you want to cook or grill!

9.title: Board Game Den
description: Bring your favourite game with you, form teams and dungeon groups to play together, there are plenty of good places to play whether it be on one of the terraces, under a shade of a tree or in a nearby gazebo.

10.title: Fursuit Parade
description: Put on your Fursuit! This afternoon, all the furries will gather. Photos, videos and eventually a group photo will be taken, we will dazzle the neighbourhood.

13.title: Sports Championship
description: Compete with others, enter the battle to win the table foosball or the ping-pong tournament where you will have to take on the toughest challenger at the end!
You can sign up for the games during registration.

15.title: Photography
description: Your paws are too big to handle the selfie stick? During the festival look for the ShutterFurs crew and book your private or small group photoshoots with them!
The recommended timeframe is right before sunset (during golden hour)!

16.title: Requests Show and Picnic
description: You know the meme: "What would be the first song that you would want to listen to on this sound system?"

Every afternoon during the outdoor picnic, while there is no DJ playing, you can ask Gali to play your favourite tunes on the main stage. Please only send links from Spotify! We will also make a collective playlist from all the music played and share it with all of you after the festival is over. Please try to stay within the boundaries of good taste and don't let a single track take up too much time, so that we can listen to as many of your favourites as possible!
